title: Sez Where? — Ask questions about your documents
excerpt: Ask a question about your document and find the relevant passages. Paste text or upload a PDF, Word document, text file, or Markdown.
content_html:
Sez Where?

Ask a question in plain language. We find relevant passages in your document, even when it uses different words.

Paste text or upload a file to get started. Read the highlighted matches in context to see what the document says.
